extraction.Name: Howard Scissons
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.NOTES: Patent was sent by mail in April 1920; signed receipt but does not remember for sure; sold land for $5000 in cash; no debts settled with purchaser; has three children; satisfied with the sale; document sworn before notary W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 1, 1929
